title: The Herbalizer Vaporizer, Vape Like A Boss (taxes extra)
description:
NO LONGER AVAILABLE

Visit herbalizerrepair.com for repairs.

NASA know how takes vaporization to new heights. Now you can control the the intensity of your experience through precise extractions — from uplifting to intense — instantly. Clean halogen technology married to sleek, luxury aesthetics, the Herbalizer is a totally different vaporization experience.

Lots of people talk about perfect vapor quality, but the Herbalizer defines it. An improved experience with instant and precise temperature adjustments — hotter or cooler, light to intense — for consistent and repeatable effects.

Features:

- +/- 5 °F temperature control

- Configurable Display °C or °F

- Optional Assisted Delivery System

- Auto Shutoff w/ Sleep Function

- Tip Over and Over Temp Auto Shutoff

- LCD display

- Magnetic Bowl

- CoolGrips™ Insulated Bowl

- SqueezeValve™ Balloon System

- 2-year Limited Warranty

- Made in the USA

Accessories:

- (1) x Herbalizer Vaporizer

- (4) x SqueezeValve™ Balloons

- (1) x 3ft Silicone Whip

- (1) x Magnetic Bowl

- (1) x Stash Box

- (1) x Grinder Card

- (1) x 2ml DeFunk

- (2) x Aromapads

- (2) x Spare Bowl Screens

- (1) x Quick Start Guide

- (1) x Vaportherapy™ Herbal Blend

- (1) x Cleaning Brush

- (1) x Power Cord

Bonus item: 4 Piece Premium Hardened Aluminum Grinder
